narrative.overview:
Xurjin connects a confident public invitation with a clear commerce workspace. The user-selected reference world combines a navy globe, blue-to-purple light, geometric X identity and human photography with white working surfaces, compact metrics and a navy navigation rail.

This replaces the former SHUAMO visual identity. The six supplied screenshots govern the direction; the implemented source governs the exact tokens below. Reference gradients are intentional brand elements, including highlighted hero text, primary calls to action, rail depth and soft supporting panels.
keyCharacteristics: Navy framing and white, softly rounded working cards.
A blue-purple geometric X with the Latin Xurjin name in both locales.
Self-hosted Manrope and Noto Sans Georgian with tabular financial figures.
Human audience imagery, a globe backdrop, and measured motion.

rules.name: The Reference Gradient Rule
rules.body: Retain the user-selected blue-to-purple gradients in their established roles; do not replace them with the discarded single-indigo palette.

rules.name: The Equal Script Rule
rules.body: Georgian and English share hierarchy, weight and usable space; allow wrapping instead of reducing one language to fit.

rules.name: The Words With State Rule
rules.body: Every status and unavailable feature needs a visible word label. Color and icons supplement its meaning.

dos: Do reuse the geometric X and spell Xurjin in Latin letters in both locales.
Do use the reference gradients, navy framing, pale blue workspace and white cards together.
Do keep financial figures tabular, render exact GEL values, and preserve visible estimate and status labels.
Do give both languages room to wrap and preserve keyboard focus, named dialogs and reduced motion.
Do distinguish demonstration marketing imagery from actual product photographs and customer evidence.
donts: Don't restore the SHUAMO wordmark, Geist typography or the old single-indigo visual restrictions.
Don't invent dashboard growth, sales, followers, commissions, partner logos or social proof to fill a reference composition.
Don't present pending approval as marketplace access, a draft profile as published, confirmed commission as paid, or Coming soon features as functional.
Don't conceal product facts, accepted terms or repair instructions behind hover-only interactions.
